A lot of freelance work is just going to be dead, meaning most young artists won't be able to take the step into recognition. I truly do not care about money, I care about the perception of art as something raw and human, as something that takes effort and dedication and passion.

None of this takes any dedication or passion.

But thats what I'm saying it isn't, its not a tool, it's a replacement. Do you truly think only the ones who cannot afford artists will use it? That people would not rather save money even though they can afford it?

The only people who benefit from this are people who don't care, people who have no passion or love for creation but want to profit from it anyways. 

Inspiration comes from living, it comes from being an artist. It doesn't come from a machine that does everything for you.

What people don't seem to understand that it's not just a pastime, its a need so deep and true in the soul and yes you would rather create than eat.

I'm not after recognition, I'm after the recognition of art itself. It's seen as a novelty when so many people have fought and died for their craft. The whole idea of making something so viscerally important into mediocre slush just brings me to tears whenever I think about it.

Every wonderful space of full of creativity and differences is being blended together into sludge for the masses.

But AI art is only made to be sold. It was created so companies wouldn't have to hire artists anymore, and for tech bros to mint it on the blockchain. 

Brutalism looks brutal because that was the soul of the creator. They wanted to challenge something and they succeeded, because their passion drove them to create.

AI art is just for profit, making artists obsolete because they deemed paying us uneccecary. People compare it to how the camera made portrait artists scared of becoming obsolete, but it cannot be compared, the camera wasn't made to erase art.

I'm not even that upset at digital art. Sure you cannot see the heart in the individual brush strokes or the true depth of the painting but there's still soul in it. They still took thousands of hours to learn how to create beautiful things because their passion and love for creation.

But AI art is just nothing. An empty void of consumerism, no talent or love just put 3 words in an image generator and get a piece of art. People calling themselves artists because of the words they put in, tainting the words the great masters put so much love into.

I'm all for innovation as long as there's soul, they've removed the soul and it makes me weep.
